decision_conditions:
Coach House
The external surfaces of the coach house (including fenestration) and, where applicable, all areas of hard surfacing shall be constructed in accordance with the details as discharged under 19/0676/DD06 dated 17/01/2024, unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Main House
The external surfaces of the Main House (including fenestration) and, where applicable, all areas of hard surfacing shall not be constructed other than in materials details/samples of which shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: To protect the historic integrity of the Listed Building
description: Variation of planning approval ref. PA25/1326 to allow for changes to ground and roof plans, including redesign of rooflights into coordinated roof lanterns, alterations to fenestration, and repositioning of doors and windows. Internal layout changes include widening of openings and alterations to access between rooms.
